config.checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation cross-entropy over the fixed200 epochs; selected and final validation both reported. No test inference.
config.recipe: SGD momentum.9, decay1e-4, crop4/flip, scalar BN, split ReLU, no dropout, real10-class readout, option-A zero-pad/downsample shortcuts. Adapted CIFAR ResNet20 recipe (He2016ResNet), NOT an exact reproduction: existing48000/1000/1000 train/validation/calibration split and RGB normalization,200epoch schedule, common5epoch warmup and AMP. Q input(0,R,G,B) has the same RGB information. Stage Q units8/16/32 give scalar widths32/64/128 versus real16/32/64: close real parameter budgets, NOT matched width/FLOPs/starting quality. Count actual weights/buffers. Same seeded batch/augmentation streams. Four Q components must pass discarded-copy update audit before training.
config.scope: Independent initialization and data-order/augmentation seeds for both real and quaternion CIFAR-10 ResNet-20 baselines, using the discovery-stage recipe and fixed split. Two seeds supplement discovery seed 2026; no test inference or hyperparameter selection on replication outcomes. These are baseline models, not yet a compression replication. The subsequent compression protocol must be registered before examining its outcomes.
config.resume: Create STOP in the active seed output to pause after a batch; resume with the same command after removing it. Completion is checkpointed each epoch.
